changelog: v5.0 — continuous correlation control. Adds correlation_taper: each holding is trimmed in proportion to its weighted average correlation to the REST of the book (onset .80, strength 16, 60d daily), iterated to a fixed point, freed weight overflowing via the cascade. No correlation threshold, no cluster partition, nothing to sit just under. ADDITIVE — cluster_cap, crowd_deconcentrate and max_weight_pct all retained; removing them holds 64% single positions and makes 2026-07 worse. Allocator retuned for the de-correlated book (tau .008->.004, vol_suppressor_k 20->40); the taper does nearly all the work (+0.039 from the tune). vs v4.3: Martin 3.642->4.278, sCopley 2.002->2.609, cvar3m -9.07->-6.83%, cvar6m -8.28->-6.24%, worst-12mo -7.94->-6.99%, MaxDD -22.28->-17.91%, both halves improve (H1 +0.676, H2 +0.288), 2026-07 unchanged, ddExceedanceUlcer .0233->.0197. Costs 0.34pp CAGR (18.16->17.82) — an OBJECTIVE CHANGE to Martin-primary, decided by Devon 2026-07-21. Evidence is a measured mechanism, not a fit: pairwise date-FE regression (n=1392, SEs clustered by date) shows correlation predicts forward co-drawdown (t=-4.51) with ZERO effect on forward return (t=0.01) while volatility predicts both; strength sits on a plateau across a 4x range. diff:holdings 59/247 months changed, no equity position above 40%. See docs/history/the-walk/the-walk-v5.md.
